'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed ①tshod myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad skyed par myi byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /dbang po rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /stobs rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par mi byed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /bsam gtan rnams 19—527

tshad yod par myi byed tshad skyed par myi byed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang ①mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /snying rje chen po tshad yod par myi byed tshad skyed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ②brtswa brgyad tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu tshad yod par myi byed tshad skyed par myi byed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu tshad yod par myi byed tshad skyed par myi byed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /rang byang chub tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /19—528

lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams tshad yod par myi byed tshad myed par myi byed do/ /zhes ①bgyi bar 'du shes su gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'du shes su gyur pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la spyod pa ma lags so// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po ba'o brgyad ②pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te yang ③byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa la gsar du zhugs pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gzugs rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /'du shes rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /'du byed rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig rgya chen por dusnyi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rna ba rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /sna rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed dodu/ /lce rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lus rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /yid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/gzugs rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /sgra rgya chen por myi byed rgya 19—529

chung ngur myi byed do/ /dri rgya chen por myi byed ①rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /ro rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /reg rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /chos rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do//sna'i rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do//lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ②ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen 19—530

por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sa'i khams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /chu'i khams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /mye'i khams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rlung gi khams rgya chen por myi byed ①rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /nam mkha'i khams rgya chen por ②phyi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ ma rig pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /'du byed rgya chen por gamyi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rnam par shes pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /mying dang gzugs rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /skye mched drug rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /reg pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /tshor ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /sred pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /len pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /srid pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur mi byed do/ /skye ba rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rga shi rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu ①phyin pa rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni⑤/ nang stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya 19—531

chung ngur myi byed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do//phyi nang stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do//myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur ①phyi byed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do / /dbang po rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /stobs rnams rgya chen por myi byed/ rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag 19—532

rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /bsam gtan rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug ①pa rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad rgya chen por myi byed rgya ②chung ngur myi byed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa sridagu rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma skyed pa dang smon pa myed pa rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /snying rje chen po ④rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /phyir myi 19—533

'ong ba'i 'bras bu rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /rang byang chub rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas ①kyi chos rnams rgya chen por myi byed rgya chung ngur myi byed do/ /zhes bgyi bar 'du shes su gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'du shes su gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa la gsar du zhugs pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas③/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gzugs mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /'du shes mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /'du byed mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu myed par myi byed do rna ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /sna mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lce mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lus mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par 19—534

myi byed do/ /yid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gzugs mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /sgra mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /dri mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /ro mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /reg mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /chos mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par mi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ①mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par mi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa mthu dang ldan par mi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu med par myi byed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu myed par myi byed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/19—535

mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ①las byung ba'i tshor ba ②mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sa'i khams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /chu'i khams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu nimyed par myi byed do/ /mye'i khams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /rlung gi khams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /nam mkha'i khams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ ma rig pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /'du byed mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rnam par shes pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /mying dang gzugs mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /skye mched drug mthu dang ldan par mi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /reg pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /tshor ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /sred pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /len pa mthu 19—536

dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /srid pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /skye ba mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rga shi mthu dang ldan par myi byed ①mthu myed par mi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /tshul khrims kyi ②pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /brtson ②'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par mi byed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dunang stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par mi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu med par myi byed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi 19—537

byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu myed par myi byed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /dbang po rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /stobs rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /byang chub kyi ①yan lag rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu med par myi byed do//'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /bsam gtan rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi 19—538

byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do//rnam par thar pa'i sgo ⑨stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/mthu myed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do//myi 'jigs pa bzhi mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /snying rje chen po mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu skyed par myi byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad mthu dang ldan par mi byed②/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mthu dang ldan par myi byed mthu myed par myi byed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /rang byang chub mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /19—539

byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams mthu dang ldan par myi byed/ mthu myed par myi byed do/ /zhes bgyi bar 'du shes su gyur na/bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'du shes su gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du ①zhe na/ gang gzugs che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa ②de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun ①pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'du shes che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'du byed che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol 0tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang myig che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rna ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sna che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lce che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ⑤mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so//gang lus che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha 19—540

rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang yid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang gzugs che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sgra che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dri che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang ro che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang reg che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung ①bar bgyid pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang chos che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang mig gi rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sna'i rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lce'i rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lus kyi rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid 19—541

pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang yid kyi rnam par shes pa ①che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang myig gi 'dus te reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sna'i 'dus te reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lce'i 'dus te reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/19—542

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sa'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang chu'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang mye'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rlung gi khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang nam mkha'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rnam par shes pa'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang ma rig pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'du byed che bar bgyid pa'am/19—543

chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang mying dang gzugs che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so//gang skye mched drug che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung ①bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sred pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang len pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ②phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang srid pa che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang skye ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rga shi che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 19—544

tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so//gang nang stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang phyi stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang phyi nang stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang chen po stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang don dam pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'dus byas stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang 19—545

rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang len pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang srid pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang skye ba mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rga shi mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu ①phyin pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthu ②dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang nang stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/19—586

mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang phyi stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am / mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang phyi nang stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang chen po stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang don dam pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'dus byas stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 19—587

phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rang bzhin stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ①ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang chos thams cad stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rang gi ②mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dran 4pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma 19—588

lags so/ /gang yang dag par spong ba rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dbang po rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang stobs rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags sol/ /gang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang bsam gtan rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang tshad myed pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid 19—589

pa'am / mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rnam par thar pa brgyad mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa myed pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang mngon par shes pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang ting nge 'dzin rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang gzungs kyi sgo rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang myi 'jigs pa rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mthu dang ldan 19—590

par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang snying rje chen po mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang dgra bcom pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang rang byang chub mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am / mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang lam gyi rnam pa rkyashes pa nyid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so/ /gang byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/19—591

mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu ma lags so༅/ /bcom ldan 'das gang ②de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/'du shes che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das/ snyede ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/myig che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rna ba che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa'am/ sna che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ lce che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ lus che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ yid che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das / ④de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ sgra che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ dri che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ro che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ reg che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ chos che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi rnam par ⑤shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/19—592

bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sa'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ chu'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ mye'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rlung gi khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ nam mkha'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am / rnam par shes pa'i khams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ma rig pa che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am / rnam par shes pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/mying dang gzugs che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ skye mched drug che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ reg pa che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba che bar bgyid pa'am chung bar bgyid pa'am/ srid pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/len pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ srid pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ skye ba che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rga shi che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs ①pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'amal/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa che 19wa 594

bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am / phyi stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/phyi nang stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ chen po stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ don dam pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'amakhya/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/19—595

dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ yang dag par spong ba rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ dbang po rnams che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa'am/ stobs rnams che bar bgyid nga 'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa che ①bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ bsam gtan rnams che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa'am/ tshad myed pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rnam par thar pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rnam ②par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'amal/ ting nge 'dzin rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/19—596

gzungs kyi sgo rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/myi 'jigs pa bzhi che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/snying rje chen po che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar ①bgyid pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu che bar bgyid pa'am / chung bar bgyid pa'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'amal/ chung bar bgyid pa'am/ rang byang chub che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa'am/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid che bar bgyid pa'am/chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams che bar bgyid pa'am/ chung bar bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'du shes 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/19—597

rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / rna ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ sna 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lce 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lus 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / yid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ sgra 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ dri 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ ro 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ reg 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / chos 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom 19—598

ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi 'dus ①te reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba 'du ②bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sa'i khams 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ chu'i khams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ mye'i khams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rlung gi khams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid 19—599

pa'am / nam mkha'i khams ①'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / rnam par shes pa'i khams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ma rig pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ mying dang gzugs 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ skye mched drug 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / reg pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ sred pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ len pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ srid pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ skye ba 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/rga shi 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 19—600

'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/phyi stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ phyi nang stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ chen po stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ don dam pa stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'dus ma byas stong pa ①nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am⑤/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol 19—601

tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ yang dag par spong ba rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ dbang po rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ stobs rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa'am/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ bsam gtan rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ tshad myed pa rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / rnam par thar pa brgyad 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ gzungs ①kyi sgo rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 19—602

'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi 'du bar bgyid pa'am/yangs par bgyid pa'am/ snying rje chen po 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad 'du bar bgyid pa'am / yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid 'du b.re bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am/ rang byang chub 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa'am / lam gyi rnam pa ①shes ②pa nyid 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ ④yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'du bar bgyid pa'am/ yangs par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmigs pa chen por 'gyur ro// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu pa④/bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba tshad 19—603

mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'du shes tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rnam ①par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rna ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ sna tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lce tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lus tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ yid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ sgra tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ dri tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ ro tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ reg tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ chos tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/19—604

rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'amal/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung 19—605

ba'i tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sa'i khams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ chu'i khams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ mye'i khams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rlung gi khams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ nam mkha'i khams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltarasheshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ma rig pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ mying dang gzugs tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ skye mched drug tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ reg pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ sred pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/19—606

tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ len pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ srid pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ skye ba tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rga shi tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ phyi stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/chen po stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma 19—607

mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am / tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rang gi ①mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran pa nye bar gzhag ②pa rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ yang dag par spong ba rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ dbang po rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ stobs rnams 19—608

tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams latshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan rnams khutshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad myed pa rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/rnam par thar pa brgyad tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ mthar kyis zhuganas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'amal/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid 19—609

pa'am / myi 'jigs pa bzhi tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi tshad mchis par bgyid pa'amal/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ snying rje chen po tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / rgyun tu zhugs ①pa'i 'bras bu tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu tshad mchis par bgyid ②pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ②ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / rang byang chub tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lam gyi ④rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa ⑤de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams tshad mchis par bgyid pa'am/tshad ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung bur bgyid pa'am/ 'du shes rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed rgya chen por bgyid pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid 19—610

pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rna ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ sna rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lce rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lus rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/yid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am / sgra rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ dri rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ ro rgya chen por bgyid pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ reg rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ chos rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi rnam zhu)par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/yid kyi rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/19—611

de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ①rgya chen por bgyid pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung zhungur bgyid pa'am/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod ②pa'i tshe/ sa'i khams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ chu'i khams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ mye'i khams rgya chen por bgyid 19—612

pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rlung gi khams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ nam mkha'i khams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa'i khams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ma rig pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rnam par shes pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ mying dang gzugs rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ skye mched drug rgya chen por bgyid pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ reg pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ①bur bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ sred pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/len pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ srid pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ skye ba rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rga shi rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i ②dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyin pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/19—613

rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/① bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am / phyi stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am / phyi nang stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ chen po stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ don dam pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/chos thams cad stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por 19—614

bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ dngos ①po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'amatshu/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ yang dag par spong ba rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ dbang po rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'amatshu/ stobs rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ bsam gtan rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ tshad myed pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rnam par thar pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/19—615

de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am / rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ①rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ myi 'jigs pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/snying rje chen po rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'amazhu/ ①rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/dgra bcom pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/rang byang chub rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa'am/ lam gyi rnam ④pa shes pa nyid rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/④ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rgya chen por bgyid pa'am/ rgya chung ngur bgyid pa de ni/ de'i 19—616

dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ tshor ba mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'du shes mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ 'du byed mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ rnam par ①shes pa mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am / mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ myig mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / rna ba mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / sna mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/lce mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ lus mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ yid mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa de ni/ de'i dmyigs pa ②chen por 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am / sgra mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ dri mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ ro mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ reg mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par bgyid pa'am/ chos mthu dang ldan par bgyid pa'am/ mthu ma mchis par 19—617
